name: Wonosobo

queries.query: Wonosobo Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN geoportal Jawa Tengah
queries.result: Found official ATR/BPN BHUMI and ATLAS documentation and the official BIG Satu Peta land-ownership layer with a Jawa Tengah sublayer. No separate Wonosobo local parcel API was identified.

queries.query: Wonosobo peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN geoportal Jawa Tengah
queries.result: Found official ATR/BPN BHUMI guidance, Wonosobo government geographic/planning pages, and the official BIG Satu Peta service. The public parcel layer is a sparse provincial land-rights dataset; Wonosobo-specific open geometry was not verified.

officialSources.operator: Badan Informasi Geospasial / BIG Satu Peta
officialSources.evidence: Public ArcGIS MapServer lists the land-ownership map and Jawa Tengah sublayer 25.

officialSources.operator: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)
officialSources.evidence: Official public BHUMI map route; official help and ATLAS pages describe public spatial land datasets including bidang tanah.
Local government planning/map page establishes local geographic context, but does not expose a cadastral parcel service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Anonymous verified-TLS request returned the service directory; land-ownership map is layer 10 and Jawa Tengah is sublayer 25.
Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, EPSG:4326 extent, objectid OID, and fields objectid, kecamatan, kelurahan, tipehak, nib, shape.

Bounded Wonosobo-city envelope 109.919,-7.365 to 109.929,-7.355 returned zero features. Wider boxes covering about 33 km and the full Wonosobo regency returned 16,479 and 21,388 features respectively; this demonstrates sparse broader coverage, not a city hit.
Attribute-filtered query returned count 0; no citywide absence is inferred.
Official BHUMI landing HTML retrieved over verified TLS.
Official public map HTML and current JavaScript bundle references retrieved; no login or private token used.
Anonymous request returned JSON HTTP 200 but no usable layer object in the response. No BHUMI feature geometry was retained.

fieldMapping.nib: Native Nomor Identifikasi Bidang field in BIG layer metadata; no Wonosobo feature was retrieved.
fieldMapping.objectid: Service OID only; not used as a retained identity.
fieldMapping.geometry: Polygon shape returned by the service when features are available.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: BIG Satu Peta land-ownership map, Jawa Tengah sublayer 25, with provincial geographic extent.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Layer is publicly queryable and has broader records, but no feature intersects the tested Wonosobo city envelope and the kecamatan filter returned zero.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: Zero exact/bounded city result is an open-layer coverage limitation, not evidence of parcel absence.

remainingUncertainty: BIG coverage is sparse and did not return Wonosobo city features. BHUMI/ATLAS is official but its anonymous feature route was not usable in this attempt. Local Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Wonosobo custody and a stable safe feature identity were not independently evidenced.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently retest BIG layer 25 around alternate Wonosobo urban boxes and the current BHUMI map/API route before any adapter admission.
